title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Ulsoor

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office in Ulsoor? SAMAN Portable manufactures and sells container offices built for businesses across Ulsoor and the wider Bengaluru area. We build each unit at our own factory in Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099, so you buy direct from the manufacturer with no middleman markup. Whether you need a compact site office near MG Road and the commercial belt around Ulsoor Lake, or a larger workspace for a growing team, we supply a ready-to-use steel office cabin you can place and start using quickly.

Container Offices for Sale in Ulsoor

SAMAN Portable supplies new container offices for sale in Ulsoor in 10ft, 20ft and 40ft sizes. Each unit is factory-built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, finished with insulated wall and roof panels, wiring points, lighting and a lockable door. We deliver and install across Ulsoor and Bengaluru, so your team gets a working office on site without a long construction wait.

Container office sizes we supply

Pick the footprint that fits your plot and headcount. All three sizes are built to the same steel-frame standard; only the floor area and layout change.

SizeTypical useFits
10ftSite office, security or supervisor cabin, single desk1–2 people
20ftTeam office, sales or project office with a small pantry/washroom3–6 people
40ftLarger office, cabins plus meeting area, or two partitioned rooms8–12 people

Layouts are customisable: add windows, an AC point, partitions, a washroom or extra power points to suit how you work. Tell us your plot size and use, and we will recommend the right configuration.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Private Limited is a manufacturer, not a reseller. You deal with the people who build the unit, which keeps the specification, quality and price clear.

  • Steel-frame build: every container office is made on an MS steel frame to IS 2062 for strength and a long working life.
  • Factory-built in Bengaluru: manufactured at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 unit and dispatched to Ulsoor.
  • Quality system: the company holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.)
  • Delivery: delivery from ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days to most Bengaluru locations.
  • Returns: returns accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

Delivery and installation in Ulsoor

Ulsoor sits in central-east Bengaluru, well connected by road, which makes delivery straightforward. We transport your finished container office by truck from our Gopasandra factory to your Ulsoor site, with delivery from ₹3,000 and a typical transit time of 3–5 days once the unit is ready. On arrival the cabin is positioned, levelled and made ready for use. For multi-unit or stackable setups, share your site access details and we will plan the placement before dispatch.

Get a container office quote in Ulsoor

Ready to price your container office for Ulsoor? Pricing depends on the size, finish and any customisation you need, so we quote each requirement individually. To get a current quote, call +91 62009 09435 or use Send Enquiry with your size and site details. You can also browse the full range on our container office collection and request pricing from there.

FAQs


What container office sizes can I buy in Ulsoor?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices in Ulsoor. The 10ft suits a single site or security office, the 20ft suits a small team, and the 40ft suits larger offices or partitioned layouts.


How long does delivery to Ulsoor take?

Once your unit is built, transit to most Bengaluru locations including Ulsoor is usually 3–5 days. Delivery starts from ₹3,000 depending on the site. We position and level the cabin on arrival.


Can I customise my container office?

Yes. You can add windows, partitions, an AC point, a washroom, extra power points and choose the internal layout. Share your plot size and how you will use the office and we will recommend a configuration.


What warranty comes with a SAMAN container office?

Each unit comes with 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years describes the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


How do I order or get a price for Ulsoor?

Call +91 62009 09435 or use Send Enquiry with your size and site details, and our team will share a current quote and lead time. You can also view the full range on our container office collection page.

author.description: Aman Dubey is the lead marketing and copywriting expert at Saman Portable, specializing in prefabricated, shipping-container, and modular structures. With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
